{{Quote|Where'd you two find an Old Republic credit in mint condition?|The creature to Wim and Neel|<ref name="PastTheBarrier" />}}
A [[Color|green]]-skinned, greasy '''individual''' was present on [[Borgo Prime]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. A patron of a local [[Unidentified noodle bar|noodle bar]], the creature witnessed the young off-[[Planet|worlders]] [[Wim]] and [[Neel]] use [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] [[Currency|coins]] and became involved in a skirmish to steal the currency from the [[youngling]]s.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Looks real enough to me. Back off or I'll pop yer breathing sac.|The creature to Vane|<ref name="PastTheBarrier" />}}
[[File:FrycookAndPatrons.png|thumb|right|250px|The greasy creature among noddle bar patrons]]
They were present at a [[Unidentified noodle bar|noodle bar]] on [[Borgo Prime]]<ref name="PastTheBarrier" /> during [[9 ABY]]<ref name="SkeletonDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> when the [[youngling]]s [[Wim]] and [[Neel]] tried to pay for a bowl of [[Unidentified noodle dish (Port Borgo)|noodles]] with an [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]]. Witnessing the [[Unidentified fry cook|fry cook]] try to get more credits from the boys, they initially warned the younglings that they were being cheated before snatching the credit from the fry cook and asking the children where they found the credit. When Neel informed the pirates that they were from [[At Attin]], the greasy creature joined gathered pirates in laughing at what they thought was the absurdity of the kids being from a legendary treasure planet. When the [[Nikto]] [[pirate]] [[Vane]] suggested that the credit must be fake and reached for it, the creature stated that it looked real to them and threatened Vane. After this interaction, Wim started a fire to distract the group and run away. However, the group of pirates and thugs chased them down and surrounded the younglings when they regrouped with [[KB]] and [[Fern]]. When the [[droid]] [[SM-33]] came to the children's rescue, the creature tried to fight him but ended up getting punched by the droid.<ref name="PastTheBarrier" />

==Personality and traits==
The creature was a greasy individual of an unidentified [[species]] with dark-green skin and bumps and scales.<ref name="PastTheBarrier" />

==Behind the scenes==
The greasy creature first appeared in the "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]]," the second episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="PastTheBarrier" /> which premiered on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="SW:2024-08-10">{{SW|url=news/skeleton-crew-official-trailer-key-art|text=''Skeleton Crew'' Official Trailer and Key Art Revealed}}</ref> Concept art of the character was done by [[Aaron McBride]]<ref name="McBride">{{Instagram|username=amcb_toraidhe|name=[[Aaron McBride]]|url=p/DSIm23zkovg|date=2025-12-11|quote=Concept done for Star Wars Skeleton Crew ( 2024 ). Really loved working on this show! This was for the surly Alien Patron in the diner on Starport Borgo in Episode 2. Design Direction / Production Designer: Doug Chiang @doug_chiang|archivefile=File:Hulking plated species Aaron McBride IG.png}}</ref> and the costume was prepared by [[Legacy Effects]].<ref name="legacyefx">{{WebCite|url=https://www.legacyefx.com/skeleton-crew|text=Skeleton Crew|work=[[Legacy Effects]]|archivedate=20250226013146}}</ref> The original concept art showed them with a [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] left arm,<ref name="McBride" /> not present in the final episode. They were performed by [[Dane DiLiegro]] and voiced by [[John Gemberling]].<ref name="PastTheBarrier" />
